study_design: Prospective population-based UK Biobank cohort study
cohort_total_n_excerpt: 253,138 eligible UK Biobank participants were included in our study.
reason: The abstract prospectively analyzes overall cancer and site-specific prostate cancer incidence but does not report an aggressive prostate cancer subtype. The 29,838 cases are all cancers and therefore are not a prostate cancer case count.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Only one site‐specific cancer, prostate cancer, was associated with omega‐3% (HR per SD = 1.03, 95% CI = 1.01–1.05, corrected p = .049) but not omega‐6% (HR per SD = 1.01, 95% CI = 0.98–1.03, corrected p = .56).
estimate_classifications.reason: The supplied full-text evidence identifies this as an estimate for site-specific incident prostate cancer generally. The abstract does not provide the numeric prostate cancer estimate for omega-6%.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Of the 19 site-specific cancers available, 14 were associated with omega-6% and five with omega-3%, all indicating inverse associations, with the exception that prostate cancer was positively associated with omega-3% (HR per SD = 1.03, 95% CI = 1.01-1.05).
estimate_classifications.reason: This is an estimate for incident prostate cancer generally, without an aggressive subtype definition.
